project.name: SmartRisk
project.description: Real-time algorithmic crypto trading signal platform with reversal zone analysis

docker.note: Container is 'django' NOT 'backend'. Env file is '.env' NOT '.env.production'

binance_api.note: MUST use .us domain — api.binance.com is geo-restricted

signal_calculation.open_candle: ALWAYS excluded via n=len(df)-1 and df.iloc[:-1] in callers
signal_calculation.alternation: BUY→SELL→BUY strictly enforced at 4 independent layers
signal_calculation.source_of_truth: PostgreSQL DB — reversal_time never changes after first INSERT

critical_rules.bar_index: NEVER in update_or_create defaults — set once on INSERT only
critical_rules.stop_loss_target: ALWAYS from calculator output — never recalculate elsewhere
critical_rules.display_source: get_reversal_zones serves DB records only (no live calculator zones)
critical_rules.live_pending: At most 1 newest zone shown from calculator — must alternate with last DB signal
critical_rules.backfill_after_formula_change: Run backfill_signals.py on server after any SL/Target formula update

frontend_chart.sl_target_lines: chart.addLineSeries() — short segments per signal (8 candles), NOT createPriceLine()
frontend_chart.label_method: lastValueVisible:true + title option on line series
frontend_chart.cleanup: chartRef.current.removeSeries(ls) — must use chart-level remove for addLineSeries
